decisions: Property occurrence can be IS_PROPERTY_OF its bearer and INSTANCE_OF its schema simultaneously.
One property occurrence at most per applicable schema/bearer; exactly one schema and bearer for each present occurrence.
A present Property has a value; a zero value minimum permits omission unless another applicable constraint requires presence.
Claim.Prose Claim: [markdown]{:0..1} permits omission or one Markdown value, not an empty Property instance.
Atom.Content.**: [markdown] supplies an inherited recursive format only; local counts and exceptions stay separate.
implementation_boundary: Structural groups may be populated through their children despite zero direct scalar values. No global one-instance Property requirement remains.
